0C9FE826F669C8F14565AF04B8D2F2EA.source: The harbourmaster's house. A brass telescope pokes out of the upstairs window, though there is no upstairs.
0C9FE826F669C8F14565AF04B8D2F2EA.target: 港务长的家。一架黄铜望远镜从楼上的窗户探出来——虽然这房子根本没有楼上。

1A19E423F5F0C8FF9C319648A4A7FA6C.source: Bless you. I came down from {Sunspire Abbey} for cheese and came away with cheese, a ribbon and a goose loaf.
1A19E423F5F0C8FF9C319648A4A7FA6C.target: 愿你蒙福。我从{日塔修道院}下来买奶酪，结果带回了奶酪、一条丝带和一个鹅形面包。

1B3FC6869D25C78311542A9B4B950FC0.source: The water glints. Probably the sun. Probably.
1B3FC6869D25C78311542A9B4B950FC0.target: 水面闪着光。大概是阳光吧。大概。

1C3C5CE73DD64B5B6D4ABEFC96D94E04.source: The whole house smells of beeswax. Even the doorknob is slightly sticky.
1C3C5CE73DD64B5B6D4ABEFC96D94E04.target: 整座房子都是蜂蜡的味道。连门把手都有点黏。

1DC4DC3DAE4AA9B70BEC131F06A413C6.source: The goose over the door? Real gold leaf. It gets stolen every year and it always comes back. I suspect it enjoys the trip.
1DC4DC3DAE4AA9B70BEC131F06A413C6.target: 门上那只鹅？是真金箔。年年被偷，年年回来。我猜它挺喜欢出门旅行的。

1EB37CA220FB22AE37CDEED4EAB87510.source: Sold my furs by noon. Now I am just here for the crowd. And the bread. Mostly the bread.
1EB37CA220FB22AE37CDEED4EAB87510.target: 不到中午毛皮就卖光了。现在我就是来凑热闹的。还有面包。主要是面包。

1FD21BF19492C370019DE4E45082461A.source: Mind you, the town is the real sight. The Abbey up on the rock, the falls coming off the cliff... worth the blisters.
1FD21BF19492C370019DE4E45082461A.target: 不过说真的，这座城才是真正的好风景。岩顶上的修道院，从悬崖上倾泻而下的瀑布……磨出水泡也值了。

2B1F8BBF49C88A16902830B72A1189F4.source: The sign says don't climb the oak. It does not say don't climb the oak AGAIN.
2B1F8BBF49C88A16902830B72A1189F4.target: 牌子上写的是别爬橡树。可没写别“再”爬橡树。

2D6D549361457F88C9EF0309E2CE04C6.source: A brass plate by the door: "{The Sunspire Bell} rings the fair closed at dusk. Kindly do not ring it yourself. — The Abbess"
2D6D549361457F88C9EF0309E2CE04C6.target: 门边有块黄铜牌：“{日塔之钟}于黄昏敲响，宣告集市结束。请勿自行敲钟。——修道院长”

3B679F424AF28EC10BC6396F7168E1BF.source: A cosy voice: "We can hear the Gildfall from our beds. We have not had a dry pillow since the spring."
3B679F424AF28EC10BC6396F7168E1BF.target: 一个温和的声音：“躺在床上都能听见鎏金瀑布。打从开春起，我们的枕头就没干过。”

3C1E19D09B7DBE6ADFE35638DA4722AF.source: A bargeman's home. Somebody inside is snoring in time with the river.
3C1E19D09B7DBE6ADFE35638DA4722AF.target: 这是一户船夫的家。屋里有人在打鼾，和着河水的节拍。

→ the {Fish Quay} · the {Piers} · the {Boathouse}

3CCFABDEDCA42E99465B56FFBAB3C403.source: Gild Fair · Stalls, crier and the Gild Well
3CCFABDEDCA42E99465B56FFBAB3C403.target: 鎏金集市 · 摊位、公告员与鎏金井

3FF07FA273B278D2E3FA8FC317D55B45.source: I walked in from the farms at dawn for this. My feet hurt and I would not be anywhere else.
3FF07FA273B278D2E3FA8FC317D55B45.target: 为了这个，我天一亮就从农庄走过来了。脚是疼，可我哪儿也不想去。

4A2C69BA92A4EBF4ED431625F07B814E.source: A tune for a penny! A sad one for two! A sad one about pennies for three!
4A2C69BA92A4EBF4ED431625F07B814E.target: 一个铜板一支曲！两个铜板来支伤心的！三个铜板来支关于铜板的伤心曲！

4ABECB3480DE34D61CBBA80EE24C8EAF.source: Welcome to {Gildhaven}, traveller. Gild Fair today, so the gate stands open and my patience stands closed.
4ABECB3480DE34D61CBBA80EE24C8EAF.target: 欢迎来到{鎏金港}，旅人。今天是鎏金集市，所以城门敞开着，我的耐心可关上了。

4B1F9578C751D551E8DEB4881EC53526.source: A long shed full of hemp and twisting rope. "Mind your fingers," calls a voice, "or you become rope."
4B1F9578C751D551E8DEB4881EC53526.target: 长长的棚屋里堆满了麻和正在绞合的绳子。有人喊道：“当心手指，不然你也会被搓成绳子！”

4B3B6C871897B6B2CA7EA87B3BF6DD50.source: Sixty-one Gild Fairs I have seen. The players get younger every year. The juggler never gets better.
4B3B6C871897B6B2CA7EA87B3BF6DD50.target: 鎏金集市我已经看过六十一回了。剧团的人一年比一年年轻，那个杂耍的却一点长进都没有。

4B290B3C3D607204F906CA2465063AD0.source: A dummy in the window wears half a very fine coat. The other half is presumably on its way.
4B290B3C3D607204F906CA2465063AD0.target: 橱窗里的人台穿着半件极其考究的外套。另外半件想必还在路上。

4B7140755F939D9DED4749547829F946.source: A duty roster is nailed to the door. Somebody has written "FAIR DAY — EVERYONE" across all of it.
4B7140755F939D9DED4749547829F946.target: 门上钉着一张值班表。有人在整张表上横着写了一行大字：“集市日——全员”。

4D2E93295F0E392C4EF1579B0B1A11DE.source: Have you seen a small boy in a red cap? Answers to "Bram", and to "cake", and to nothing else.
4D2E93295F0E392C4EF1579B0B1A11DE.target: 你见过一个戴红帽子的小男孩吗？叫他“布拉姆”会应，叫“蛋糕”也会应，别的一概不理。

4D42F10E658769D734B5EDC744307C8D.source: The apples come from {Pippin Orchard} up in {High Town}. The toffee comes from me. The teeth are your own business.
4D42F10E658769D734B5EDC744307C8D.target: 苹果来自{上城}的{皮平果园}，太妃糖出自我的手。至于牙齿嘛，那是你自己的事。

04E3CACB9C3FBD1FCA6E6E10A2B4CACE.source: Cheese. Hard cheese, soft cheese, cheese that walks to you if you leave it long enough. Taste? It is free. The second taste is not.
04E3CACB9C3FBD1FCA6E6E10A2B4CACE.target: 奶酪。硬奶酪、软奶酪，还有放得够久就会自己走过来的奶酪。尝尝？免费的。第二口就不免费了。

5B39ADD4A42BC3336AE58A6AE7D9B6C1.source: Gildhaven Hall. The Lord Mayor is receiving in the court — just there, by the benches. Please do not curtsey into the flower boxes.
5B39ADD4A42BC3336AE58A6AE7D9B6C1.target: 这里是鎏金港市政厅。市长大人正在庭院会客——就在那边长椅旁。行礼时请别一头栽进花箱里。

5B755B811F009291C8EB75C08E76091A.source: HEAR YE, HEAR YE! The Gild Fair is OPEN! Stalls on the square, players in {Fairfield}, and fish on the {Fish Quay}!
5B755B811F009291C8EB75C08E76091A.target: 听好了，听好了！鎏金集市开市啦！摊位在广场，剧团在{集原}，鱼在{鱼码头}！

5B164482F157FA1D93A4A7F0ECED7F9A.source: The {Shrine of the Tide} keeps the names of the boats. Those that came home, and those that did not.
5B164482F157FA1D93A4A7F0ECED7F9A.target: {潮汐神龛}记着每条船的名字。有归来的，也有没能归来的。

5BA41B68FA911BE1C014AA8AAA18E95A.source: Clap on the off-beat, if you please. Florin is always half a beat ahead, and somebody has to drag him back.
5BA41B68FA911BE1C014AA8AAA18E95A.target: 劳驾，请在反拍上拍手。弗洛林总是抢半拍，总得有人把他拽回来。

5C82BBC61C5177B76E730F43E1150920.source: It tastes of water. Very good water, to be fair.
5C82BBC61C5177B76E730F43E1150920.target: 尝起来就是水。平心而论，是相当好的水。

5DB2B9C754230E6FC4FDEE01BA00FB51.source: Bottles of every colour line the window. One of them is gently bubbling. You decide not to ask.
5DB2B9C754230E6FC4FDEE01BA00FB51.target: 窗台上排满了各色瓶子。其中一瓶正在轻轻冒泡。你决定还是别问了。

06AB00D312898294B6E0AC5157615864.source: I am not CHASING them. I am HERDING them. There is a difference and the difference is I am winning.
06AB00D312898294B6E0AC5157615864.target: 我才不是在“追”它们！我是在“赶”它们！这可不一样，不一样的地方就是我赢了！

6BC51C416E11FBA607B3A2A7FB70AA77.source: A sign in the window: "Shoes mended. Boots mended. Hearts not mended, try the Abbey."
6BC51C416E11FBA607B3A2A7FB70AA77.target: 窗上的牌子写着：“修鞋。修靴。不修心——请去修道院。”

6BD2EF5AAC3C91C3C6481C1F3F9F43ED.source: I build boats. Little ones for the river, bigger ones for the harbour. The biggest one is still a dream and some sawdust.
6BD2EF5AAC3C91C3C6481C1F3F9F43ED.target: 我造船。小的给河上用，大一点的给港口用。最大的那条，目前还只是一个梦和一堆木屑。

6F4385E3B41339273BE08BDE990C0AC5.source: Welcome to {Gildhaven}, traveller, on the best day of our year. I am Odelia Fairgild, Lord Mayor — "Lord" because the charter is very old and nobody likes paperwork.
6F4385E3B41339273BE08BDE990C0AC5.target: 欢迎来到{鎏金港}，旅人，今天可是我们一年中最好的日子。我是奥德莉亚·费尔吉尔德，本城的市长“老爷”——叫“老爷”是因为特许状年代太久，而谁都不爱办文书手续。

7D46D38CF851B61B19061D794746AF2A.source: Market Day on the River Gild

7E515CF0F8CB01FB2B480DB1D7800D0F.source: I weave the river-blue that Signora Vell sells on the square. She sells it for three times what she pays me. I weave slower on Mondays.
7E515CF0F8CB01FB2B480DB1D7800D0F.target: 维尔夫人在广场上卖的河蓝布是我织的。她的卖价是付我工钱的三倍。所以每逢星期一，我就织得慢一点。

7F88B86F305B33E25D6A4167E604A119.source: The chandlers on {Market Street}, probably. They have everything.
7F88B86F305B33E25D6A4167E604A119.target: 大概是{市场街}上那家杂货铺吧。他们什么都有。

7F323D54EDEA406DFBA9650C92A1743F.source: I walked from the coast to hear the {Sunspire Bell}. Three weeks. My boots are holier than I am.
7F323D54EDEA406DFBA9650C92A1743F.target: 为了听{日塔之钟}，我从海边一路走来。走了三个星期。我靴子上磨出的洞，比我积下的功德还多。

8C09419D9D0313199C1EE88ED0953A89.source: Flour on the doorstep, flour on the knocker, flour on you now.
8C09419D9D0313199C1EE88ED0953A89.target: 门阶上是面粉，门环上是面粉，现在你身上也是面粉。

8E0BC14AD3BA0F6BEAC76C4918623A6F.source: Hoops and staves everywhere. A half-made barrel rocks gently, like it is thinking about rolling off.
8E0BC14AD3BA0F6BEAC76C4918623A6F.target: 到处都是铁箍和桶板。一只做了一半的木桶轻轻摇晃，像是在考虑要不要滚走。

9B10EEF6C6CCD54F8EDDA4C95710D051.source: Three days up the river from the sea, and every lock-keeper wanted a fair-day tip. My barge has gone back down without me. I stayed for the cheese.
9B10EEF6C6CCD54F8EDDA4C95710D051.target: 从海边逆流而上走了三天，每个闸门看守都想讨一份集市日的小费。我的驳船已经撇下我顺流回去了。我是为了奶酪才留下的。

09CD269777B4CEF054EC99329FABB17C.source: The players out in {Fairfield} have a fiddle. I have a pipe and a good loud hat. We are not rivals. They are simply wrong.
09CD269777B4CEF054EC99329FABB17C.target: {集原}那边的剧团有把提琴。我有支笛子，外加一顶够花哨的帽子。我们不是对手。只是他们错了而已。

9CE71A84EF9638AE7344F3A30C9539E3.source: Roses climb all the way to the chimney. A voice: "If you have come about the roses, they are not for sale. They are for showing off."
9CE71A84EF9638AE7344F3A30C9539E3.target: 玫瑰一路爬上了烟囱。一个声音说：“要是为玫瑰而来，那可不卖。这是种来炫耀的。”

9D99B107CDE6EF0B7C4D5E9C93289BCD.source: Will you stay for the bell at dusk?
9D99B107CDE6EF0B7C4D5E9C93289BCD.target: 您会留下来听黄昏的钟声吗？

9E1C92A3285882FF6D7814F1A8CB2430.source: The smell of pitch and sawdust. Somebody inside is singing to a boat. The boat does not seem to mind.
9E1C92A3285882FF6D7814F1A8CB2430.target: 满是沥青和木屑的气味。有人在里面对着一条船唱歌。船似乎并不介意。

9EC51FD6A909A8F5B86F2ABD6B48E380.source: "BARLOW'S EGGS — the best in Fairfield" is painted over the door. Underneath, smaller: "the only in Fairfield".
9EC51FD6A909A8F5B86F2ABD6B48E380.target: 门楣上漆着“巴洛鸡蛋——集原最好”。下面一行小字：“集原唯一”。

9F9E895FC9EC791ADB92EAB2EAAFB6C2.source: "Back in five minutes," says the note. It has said so since this morning.
9F9E895FC9EC791ADB92EAB2EAAFB6C2.target: 纸条上写着：“五分钟后回来。”从今天早上起就一直这么写着。

10FF8417841194101C16E5251AB31CE9.source: Smoked Gild trout, fresh off the fire at the end of the quay. Smoked eel for the brave.
10FF8417841194101C16E5251AB31CE9.target: 烟熏鎏金鳟鱼，码头尽头刚下火的。胆子大的还可以来条熏鳗鱼。

18EE4F4954AAD9FCBE5BEFCBE876507F.source: Trade is the river that runs under the river, friend. And this is a very good day for it.
18EE4F4954AAD9FCBE5BEFCBE876507F.target: 贸易是河底下流淌的另一条河，朋友。而今天正是它涨水的好日子。

19BC56E7A6AAC0D02A594EC3D3C6A58B.source: Saffron, pepper, cinnamon bark — all the way up the river by barge, all the way from the sea.
19BC56E7A6AAC0D02A594EC3D3C6A58B.target: 藏红花、胡椒、肉桂皮——坐驳船沿河而上，从大海那边一路运来的。

19BE7D65C8037BEBA6A88193AEC5C136.source: Upturned boats inside, and a dozen oars, and a gull that very clearly lives here now.
19BE7D65C8037BEBA6A88193AEC5C136.target: 里面倒扣着几条船，还有十来支桨，以及一只显然已经在这儿安了家的海鸥。

20D5BA0112D1E339D203FC9E3D2235A6.source: Market Day on the River Gild

22E3A2E42AED13CEFF0A10580A017801.source:
↘ {The Lookout} over the {Gild Pool}
↙ the {Harbour Stair} down to the {North Quay}
22E3A2E42AED13CEFF0A10580A017801.target:
↘ {瞭望台}，俯瞰{鎏金潭}
↙ {港口石阶}，下至{北码头}

35C8502AC71DAC06C7C3435A2EEF6284.source: Fair day means horseshoes, cart-pins and cauldron handles. Nobody buys a sword on fair day. Too much joy in the air.
35C8502AC71DAC06C7C3435A2EEF6284.target: 集市日要的是马蹄铁、车辖和锅把手。集市日没人买剑。空气里欢乐太多了。

41EB83D23D06A802D0EE7C99D898BCA7.source: Quiet fair so far. One stolen purse, one lost child — found asleep in a haystack in {Fairfield} — and the goose went missing from the inn again. It will turn up.
41EB83D23D06A802D0EE7C99D898BCA7.target: 目前集市还算太平。一个钱袋被偷，一个孩子走失——后来发现在{集原}的干草堆里睡着了——还有旅店的那只鹅又不见了。它会回来的。

45C28EAA732F5DE3C8FC66464CD4EA03.source: The sergeant counts everyone who comes in. I count everyone who goes out. We have never once agreed.
45C28EAA732F5DE3C8FC66464CD4EA03.target: 中士数进城的人，我数出城的人。我们俩的数从来没对上过。

46D63390EFFA41EFFFA73920A6634C62.source: The {Gild Pool}. The barges came up at dawn, unloaded for the fair and went straight back down to the sea for more. Now it is just us and the gulls.
46D63390EFFA41EFFFA73920A6634C62.target: 这里是{鎏金潭}。驳船天亮时上来，为集市卸完货就直接顺流回海边再去装货了。现在只剩我们和海鸥。

46E807C70E5CFF990A5538A7B67FD95B.source: Barlow's the name, eggs are the game. Brown eggs, white eggs, and one blue egg nobody can explain.
46E807C70E5CFF990A5538A7B67FD95B.target: 巴洛是我名，鸡蛋是我行。红皮蛋、白皮蛋，还有一个谁也说不清来历的蓝皮蛋。

47AD9ECA7325D866D9158C6726978657.source: Bread! Bread! Bread with seeds, bread without seeds, bread shaped like a goose for the fair.
47AD9ECA7325D866D9158C6726978657.target: 面包！面包！有籽的面包，没籽的面包，还有为集市特制的鹅形面包！

47AD7100E4F94E6B6226FA9EB16D5E66.source: Forty years I have fished the Gild. On fair day the trout hide under the barges, sulking at the noise.
47AD7100E4F94E6B6226FA9EB16D5E66.target: 我在鎏金河上打了四十年鱼。一到集市日，鳟鱼就躲到驳船底下，嫌吵在那儿生闷气。

48DF207BC2AEC1100D8FD79F629BA240.source: Shh. They are biting. Or they were, until you walked down the pier like a drum.
48DF207BC2AEC1100D8FD79F629BA240.target: 嘘。鱼正咬钩呢。至少在你像敲鼓一样踩着栈桥走过来之前是这样。

50E63A73BF660610CC8F0EF3DC97CAD8.source: Flour dust puffs out under the door. The millstones rumble like a giant clearing its throat.
50E63A73BF660610CC8F0EF3DC97CAD8.target: 面粉从门底下噗噗地冒出来。磨盘隆隆作响，像巨人在清嗓子。

51AC0C6C5C82DF4D69341EFA7F802F8D.source: "Letters written, read, and — for a small extra fee — improved."
51AC0C6C5C82DF4D69341EFA7F802F8D.target: “代写书信，代读书信，另付少许费用——还可代为润色。”

54BE1FAEB7181036FE08FA1E30D0D43A.source: Mother {Celandine} rings the {Sunspire Bell}, the fair closes, and we light lanterns all along the river. The water turns to gold for a night. That is the real gild of {Gildhaven}.
54BE1FAEB7181036FE08FA1E30D0D43A.target: {塞兰丁}院长会敲响{日塔之钟}，集市落幕，我们会沿河点亮灯笼。河水会化作一夜的金色。那才是{鎏金港}真正的“鎏金”。

58DC89F8241EFBBDC110342318EF69E3.source: Eggs from Barlow's Farm, hens from my own yard. Those four by the stall are not for sale. They are staff.
58DC89F8241EFBBDC110342318EF69E3.target: 鸡蛋来自巴洛农场，母鸡是我自家院子养的。摊子旁边那四只可不卖，它们是员工。

62D3D35F3063742FE02671E2E2090FC3.source: Gulls took my lunch, my bait and my hat. I am keeping the rod out of spite.
62D3D35F3063742FE02671E2E2090FC3.target: 海鸥叼走了我的午饭、鱼饵，还有帽子。我偏要把鱼竿留着，气死它们。

72BB05CD5B02C81EDD01F62AC7B92F02.source: The {Barrelhouse}! Gild Ale, brown as the river and twice as strong. We brew it with water from the falls.
72BB05CD5B02C81EDD01F62AC7B92F02.target: {酒桶屋}！鎏金麦酒，颜色跟河水一样棕，劲头却比河水猛两倍。用瀑布的水酿的。

78F3FA83A5F900700DBA8624794BD7DC.source: Marigolds for the fair! You wear them to the bell at dusk, then throw them in the river for luck.
78F3FA83A5F900700DBA8624794BD7DC.target: 集市的金盏花！戴着它去听黄昏的钟声，然后扔进河里讨个好运。

79F9EDA1D20C6CD4633AFC3BCAB2EFF1.source: Dozens of clocks tick inside, none of them together. It is, apparently, every time at once.
79F9EDA1D20C6CD4633AFC3BCAB2EFF1.target: 屋里几十座钟滴答作响，没有两座是同步的。看来此刻同时是所有的时间。

83F0F43B3E3941073CB5CFA6AB0EB553.source:
{Pippin Orchard}
Apples for the fair: take one, leave a coin.
83F0F43B3E3941073CB5CFA6AB0EB553.target:
{皮平果园}
集市苹果：拿一个，留一枚硬币。

86E7251F7EDC4D02FEEE22E7319B5E60.source: Me? Just browsing. Admiring. Absolutely not counting anyone's purse.
86E7251F7EDC4D02FEEE22E7319B5E60.target: 我？随便逛逛。欣赏欣赏。绝对没在数谁的钱袋。

90CC78A6F3454BD3DB54CCEEBB33F535.source: Stand on the {Mistbridge} when the sun is low — the spray glitters like the gold dust of the old stories. Free of charge, which is more than my cousin can say.
90CC78A6F3454BD3DB54CCEEBB33F535.target: 太阳西斜时站到{雾桥}上——水雾闪闪发亮，就像老故事里的金沙。还不收钱，这可是我堂兄比不了的。

111AFA07C5179264FDB7AC85D426ADBB.source: Warm steam curls out under the door. "Baths half price on fair day," says the slate. "Soap extra. Singing free."
111AFA07C5179264FDB7AC85D426ADBB.target: 暖暖的蒸汽从门底下袅袅飘出。石板上写着：“集市日沐浴半价。肥皂另计。唱歌免费。”

138DEE550B52D927332E1BD1D9DA7E44.source: The Wandering Lark Players · Today only
138DEE550B52D927332E1BD1D9DA7E44.target: 流浪云雀剧团 · 仅限今日

225A780518B91A54F7761CA0A63748C0.source: Peace on your fair day. I am the Abbess of {Sunspire Abbey}. At dusk I ring the bell, and the whole town stops to listen.
225A780518B91A54F7761CA0A63748C0.target: 愿你的集市日平安。我是{日塔修道院}的院长。黄昏时我会敲钟，全城都会停下来聆听。

264C212DCD9E0DBBDDD371CA97F37525.source: A wheel leans by the door, waiting for its cart. It looks like it has been waiting a while.
264C212DCD9E0DBBDDD371CA97F37525.target: 门边靠着一只车轮，在等它的车。看样子已经等了好一阵子了。

450BA8F7D7A5606140BAAD67739CE176.source: Tired already? Rest now and you'll miss the bell at dusk.
450BA8F7D7A5606140BAAD67739CE176.target: 这就累了？现在歇下，可就要错过黄昏的钟声啦。

513EBEEA448B8C9E4EF07AB061BDD74D.source: Mind the Grand Stair behind me — three hundred years of feet have made it slippy as a wet eel.
513EBEEA448B8C9E4EF07AB061BDD74D.target: 当心我身后的大石阶——三百年来被人踩来踩去，滑得跟条湿鳗鱼似的。

605A98E94B551673756DC147881A4346.source: My barge went back down to the sea at noon. Left me here with a pocketful of coin and no boat. I call that a holiday.
605A98E94B551673756DC147881A4346.target: 我的驳船中午就顺流回海边了，把我留在这儿，兜里装满了钱，却没了船。我管这叫度假。

631B00BE58360E7423C9114D88BEB18D.source: Lanterns of every size hang in the window, waiting for dusk like children waiting for a story.
631B00BE58360E7423C9114D88BEB18D.target: 窗里挂着大大小小的灯笼，等着黄昏，就像孩子们等着听故事。

633D9E6F67E7C4633FCE95388C09E4C2.source: I polish the candlesticks, I sweep the steps, and at dusk I am allowed to hold the rope while Mother Celandine rings the bell. It is the best job in {Gildhaven}.
633D9E6F67E7C4633FCE95388C09E4C2.target: 我擦烛台，扫台阶，黄昏时塞兰丁院长敲钟，我还可以帮忙拉着绳子。这是{鎏金港}最好的差事。

671F92C2C7ADC7DAC01C4A78F1071941.source: No school today. I said so on the slate. Twice. And on the door. And to every child personally.
671F92C2C7ADC7DAC01C4A78F1071941.target: 今天不上课。我在石板上写了。写了两遍。门上也写了。还挨个跟每个孩子说了。

771E39F8440EEDD65CBDFDB2BAC242C9.source: A footman opens the door an inch: "The Lord Mayor is receiving in the court today, as it is fair day. And as it is sunny."
771E39F8440EEDD65CBDFDB2BAC242C9.target: 一名男仆把门开了一条缝：“市长大人今日在庭院中会客，因为今天是集市日。也因为今天阳光正好。”

861F32BD2A53725DC04B04528F1E3725.source: Where the Gild leaves High Town

920E72E955D0A104D67126EDDA4B90F8.source: The {Gilt Library}: four thousand books, three readers, and one cat who sleeps on the rarest of them.
920E72E955D0A104D67126EDDA4B90F8.target: {镀金书库}：四千本书，三位读者，还有一只专挑最珍贵的那本睡觉的猫。

932F193F169EE10BAE32C0D0CEB41830.source: Blue, gold and red cloth hangs drying inside. The dyer's hands are, you suspect, all three colours.
932F193F169EE10BAE32C0D0CEB41830.target: 屋里晾着蓝、金、红三色的布。你猜染匠的手大概也是这三种颜色。

940F0F7F25C3CF29DAD8DE5C7F5F1C28.source: "Come in if you are a grandchild, go away if you are selling something, and wipe your feet either way."
940F0F7F25C3CF29DAD8DE5C7F5F1C28.target: “是孙辈就进来，是推销的就走开，不管哪种都先擦擦脚。”

2826B15AFD7FF9466FB74315132F640D.source: Lady {Odelia Fairgild}. She receives in the court of {Gildhaven Hall} on fair day — up the {Grand Stair} and west along {Crown Walk}, over the Hall Bridge.
2826B15AFD7FF9466FB74315132F640D.target: {奥德莉亚·费尔吉尔德}夫人。集市日她在{鎏金港市政厅}的庭院会客——走上{大石阶}，沿{王冠步道}往西，过了市政厅桥就到。

3373E6C5B0BBD5EC58ADD570C54F069E.source: I keep the Rampart lawns and the Abbey beds. Every fair, somebody sits on my marigolds. Every fair, I forgive them. Barely.
3373E6C5B0BBD5EC58ADD570C54F069E.target: 我照管城墙边的草坪和修道院的花圃。每逢集市，总有人坐到我的金盏花上。每逢集市，我都会原谅他们。勉强原谅。

4083BAAE1CEDB8E496E920F99E8A99E5.source: Shh! I am hiding from Mum. If she says "cake", I have to come out. It is the rules.
4083BAAE1CEDB8E496E920F99E8A99E5.target: 嘘！我在躲妈妈。要是她喊“蛋糕”，我就得出来。这是规矩。

4492B9602FEF3B640140E4EB2E187885.source: We play the Gild Fair every year. The town pays us in pies, and the pies are worth the walk.
4492B9602FEF3B640140E4EB2E187885.target: 我们每年都来鎏金集市演出。镇上拿馅饼当酬劳，而那些馅饼值得我们走这一趟。

4916F80F74705A05E26C8EECAE564759.source: The {Lookout}. From here I can see both piers of the {Gild Pool}, every roof in the lower town and the road all the way to the gate.
4916F80F74705A05E26C8EECAE564759.target: 这里是{瞭望台}。从这儿能看到{鎏金潭}的两座栈桥、下城的每一片屋顶，还有一直通到城门的大路。

6036ECFE7408534AD688F48F3ECF4288.source: Sit down, sit down. The best view of fair day is a bench and a friend.
6036ECFE7408534AD688F48F3ECF4288.target: 坐，坐。看集市日最好的位置，就是一张长椅加一位朋友。

6661FD1F620FF3E78E41EB790A59CB3F.source: Mind your backs! Barrels for the {Barrelhouse}, cheese for the square, and a harp for — honestly, I do not know who orders a harp.
6661FD1F620FF3E78E41EB790A59CB3F.target: 借过借过！酒桶送{酒桶屋}，奶酪送广场，竖琴送——说实话，我也不知道谁会订竖琴。

8328D8DD5C28653E0F470B11D954693C.source: Through the door: the clatter of an abacus and somebody saying "Twelve barrels? I said TWO barrels!"
8328D8DD5C28653E0F470B11D954693C.target: 门里传来算盘噼啪作响，还有人在嚷：“十二桶？我说的是‘两’桶！”

9196D23597E11E44D44EA58FADC3D17A.source: If you catch my boy {Nim} chasing the hens again, tell him supper is when the {Sunspire Bell} rings.
9196D23597E11E44D44EA58FADC3D17A.target: 要是你撞见我家小子{尼姆}又在追母鸡，告诉他，{日塔之钟}一响就开饭。

9664E70197DF0BD7E78FC8C7EB85C547.source: Mending nets, dear. Every hole is a fish that got away and a story that got bigger.
9664E70197DF0BD7E78FC8C7EB85C547.target: 在补网呢，孩子。每个破洞都是一条溜走的鱼，和一个越讲越大的故事。

12604C5D699E304F12A9396B398769EB.source: Ah, an audience! The {Wandering Lark Players}, at your service — songs, dances, and one juggler who is mostly reliable.
12604C5D699E304F12A9396B398769EB.target: 啊，有观众了！{流浪云雀剧团}为您效劳——唱歌、跳舞，外加一位大体上还算靠得住的杂耍艺人。

31031B9E0EF7B2E84EB853FF93C0C05A.source: Sawdust drifts from the door. A half-finished rocking horse stares at you with one painted eye.
31031B9E0EF7B2E84EB853FF93C0C05A.target: 木屑从门口飘出来。一匹做了一半的摇摇马用一只画好的眼睛盯着你。

94362DD60A6301C3AD9CB44967B88689.source: You came over the {Hall Bridge}? Then you have crossed the Gild twice today — once up here as a stream, once down there as a river.
94362DD60A6301C3AD9CB44967B88689.target: 你是从{市政厅桥}过来的？那你今天已经两次跨过鎏金河了——一次在上面，它还是条小溪；一次在下面，它已是条大河。

235820D9AEFFBE66470556F3F488C159.source: I am counting pigeons. There are six. There were seven. I think one went to {High Town} to be fancy.
235820D9AEFFBE66470556F3F488C159.target: 我在数鸽子。现在有六只。刚才有七只。我觉得有一只跑去{上城}装阔气了。

287403F2CF413E7845FFF1FFDDEE83AA.source: Bundles of drying herbs hang so thick inside that the room looks like a little forest.
287403F2CF413E7845FFF1FFDDEE83AA.target: 屋里挂满了一捆捆晾着的草药，密得像一片小树林。

368980EE2A025D2BECA6CA04F8814EC3.source: River-blue cloth, dyed in the {West Quarter} and fit for a duchess. Feel it. No — gently. GENTLY.
368980EE2A025D2BECA6CA04F8814EC3.target: 河蓝布，在{西区}染的，公爵夫人穿都够格。摸摸看。不不——轻点。轻、点！

2647257B983331D3B005583EA3EC393E.source: A wheel hums inside. A pot slumps. Somebody sighs, then laughs, then starts again.
2647257B983331D3B005583EA3EC393E.target: 屋里的转盘嗡嗡转着。一只陶坯塌了下去。有人叹了口气，接着笑了，然后从头再来。

3083617D224D80DBBAF7CC20A7405644.source:
→ the {Mistbridge} to the {North Quay}
↓ {Mill Lane} to {Market Street}
3083617D224D80DBBAF7CC20A7405644.target:
→ {雾桥}，通往{北码头}
↓ {磨坊巷}，通往{市场街}

9428912C6F9487E9B40133515EC28058.source: A sign: "ALL BARGES TO DECLARE ALL CARGO. Including cheese. ESPECIALLY cheese."
9428912C6F9487E9B40133515EC28058.target: 告示写着：“所有驳船须申报全部货物。包括奶酪。尤其是奶酪！”

37207338BC5CE11D62CAA2B164447D3F.source: The brass knocker is shaped like a quill. Knocking with it leaves a small ink stain on your knuckles.
37207338BC5CE11D62CAA2B164447D3F.target: 黄铜门环做成了羽毛笔的形状。敲过之后，你的指节上留下了一小块墨渍。

03471569420C6A2C38AE9BAE838BC40A.source: My cousin runs the windmill out in {Fairfield}. I run the water mill under the {Gildfall}. We do not speak of whose flour is better. Mine is.
03471569420C6A2C38AE9BAE838BC40A.target: 我堂兄在{集原}管风车磨坊，我管{鎏金瀑布}底下的水磨坊。我们从不谈谁家的面粉更好。是我家的。

81350712495CAC35322FE17376E358CE.source: Barrels rumble somewhere inside. A cheerful bellow: "We are OPEN, it is FAIR DAY, and the ale is BROWN!"
81350712495CAC35322FE17376E358CE.target: 里面不知哪里有木桶在隆隆滚动。一声欢快的大吼：“开门营业啦！今天是集市日！麦酒是棕色的！”

55902458214493B1E81B2838C828CE49.source: The Guild Exchange sets the price of everything sold on the square today. Everything. Even the turnip the juggler drops.
55902458214493B1E81B2838C828CE49.target: 今天广场上卖的每样东西，价格都由行会交易所来定。每一样。连杂耍艺人掉下来的萝卜也不例外。

477381773248679587397892151A630B.source: Stand back from the forge, friend. Sparks do not care whose coat they land on.
477381773248679587397892151A630B.target: 离炉子远点，朋友。火星可不管落在谁的外套上。

A1F6FD067A56B3C9FB691B62EA2516EB.source: A wooden soldier in the window salutes as the door creaks. Clever springs.
A1F6FD067A56B3C9FB691B62EA2516EB.target: 门吱呀一响，橱窗里的木头士兵就敬了个礼。好巧妙的弹簧。

A3FBF9087B77A679C675B14C9140F9B8.source: Do you know {Kit}? Kit climbs the oak on {Bellgreen} even though there is a sign. There is a sign because of Kit.
A3FBF9087B77A679C675B14C9140F9B8.target: 你认识{基特}吗？{钟声草坪}上明明立着牌子，基特还是要爬那棵橡树。那块牌子就是因为基特才立的。

A6FF400D98E9C66C0CF65C4317CAD94C.source: The door is warm. Behind it: saffron, butter and a very busy oven.
A6FF400D98E9C66C0CF65C4317CAD94C.target: 门摸上去暖暖的。门后是藏红花、黄油，还有一座忙个不停的烤炉。

A30B7264A0702FC239EDDD3A1B5F9A38.source: Laughter, a fiddle and the smell of roast apples spill out of {The Gilded Goose}.
A30B7264A0702FC239EDDD3A1B5F9A38.target: 笑声、提琴声和烤苹果的香气从{金鹅旅店}里飘了出来。

A0931F8B4FCFADAAA4D700653DC25687.source: Market Square is straight up {Main Street}. Fair stalls, the players and the mill are out here in {Fairfield}.
A0931F8B4FCFADAAA4D700653DC25687.target: 沿着{大街}一直往上就是市场广场。集市摊位、剧团和磨坊都在外头的{集原}。

A3726D4A560802ABF541006E550AE1F2.source: Toffee apples! Dipped this morning, sticky till midnight.
A3726D4A560802ABF541006E550AE1F2.target: 太妃糖苹果！今早现蘸的糖衣，一直黏到半夜！

A14662D18B0B3C5EEFCCB84F948B074A.source:
{Bellgreen}
Please do not climb the oak. (It means you, Kit.)
A14662D18B0B3C5EEFCCB84F948B074A.target:
{钟声草坪}
请勿攀爬橡树。（说的就是你，基特。）

A9633939A535629FBFB4688284C92A5A.source: If you see a little boy with a toffee apple and no shoes, that is {Nim}. He is fine. He is always fine.
A9633939A535629FBFB4688284C92A5A.target: 要是看见一个拿着太妃糖苹果、光着脚的小男孩，那就是{尼姆}。他没事。他向来都没事。

AC98806681778FD208D2032971E23797.source: The great door stands ajar. Inside, a hundred candles and one very patient choir.
AC98806681778FD208D2032971E23797.target: 大门虚掩着。里面燃着上百支蜡烛，还有一支极有耐心的唱诗班。

AD1D21165BB1A2A87C67F41E57D26125.source: Carpenter. I made half the stalls on the square, and all the benches. If one wobbles, it was the other half.
AD1D21165BB1A2A87C67F41E57D26125.target: 我是木匠。广场上一半的摊位和所有长椅都是我做的。要是哪个晃悠，那肯定是另一半。

ADABFB5816B6F9DE6151533E97B352DD.source: East Pier for fishing, West Pier for gossip. Gran Tessaly mends nets down on the beach, past the smokehouse.
ADABFB5816B6F9DE6151533E97B352DD.target: 东栈桥钓鱼，西栈桥聊闲话。泰莎莉阿婆在下面海滩上补网，就在熏鱼坊过去一点。

B1AD0E3E917568177C39760426E5C1F5.source: The ring of a hammer stops. "If you want a horseshoe, wait. If you want a sword, wait longer. If you want to chat, Rurik is outside."
B1AD0E3E917568177C39760426E5C1F5.target: 叮当的锤声停了下来。“要马蹄铁，等着。要剑，等更久。要聊天，留里克在外面。”

B3F6FF5FF045A36FF23CFDD6834DA1AA.source: You should see the {Gild Pool} past the {Barge Quay} — gulls stealing everything that is not nailed down, and some things that are.
B3F6FF5FF045A36FF23CFDD6834DA1AA.target: 你该去看看{驳船码头}那头的{鎏金潭}——海鸥见什么偷什么，没钉死的全偷，钉死的也偷几样。

B5FD0C8172B10C8691AD5FEB9CE7AC4A.source: Cups, jugs, and a teapot that pours almost entirely into the cup. Almost.
B5FD0C8172B10C8691AD5FEB9CE7AC4A.target: 杯子、水罐，还有一把几乎能把茶全倒进杯里的茶壶。几乎。

B6AC83A6E665EBF4FA047E5D6F34F94E.source: They still came. They are at the fair now, learning arithmetic from the cheese stall.
B6AC83A6E665EBF4FA047E5D6F34F94E.target: 可他们还是来了。现在都去了集市，在奶酪摊上学算术呢。

B8A96F7ED0805F93575FCBAF0FB9021A.source: A card in the window: "SILENCE. (This means you, the fair.)"
B8A96F7ED0805F93575FCBAF0FB9021A.target: 窗上贴着一张卡片：“肃静！（说的就是你，集市。）”

B32BB88E4F65F5E2B7645A6B4A2930AC.source: Shells and smooth stones line the doorstep: offerings for boats that come home, and for some that did not.
B32BB88E4F65F5E2B7645A6B4A2930AC.target: 门阶上摆满了贝壳和光滑的石子：献给平安归来的船，也献给那些没能回来的。

B63FD403F610ECFE4A7A918E32B30664.source: Hob has been on that bench since the fair opened. I have been on this one. We are having a lovely day together.
B63FD403F610ECFE4A7A918E32B30664.target: 集市一开张，霍布就坐在那张长椅上了。我就坐在这张上。我们一起过了美好的一天。

B084EDA188AF0ADDBEC078DF97A7C18B.source: Lamplighter. Every lamp from the {South Gate} to the {Rampart Walk} — I light them all at dusk, one by one.
B084EDA188AF0ADDBEC078DF97A7C18B.target: 我是点灯人。从{南门}到{城墙步道}的每一盏灯——黄昏时都由我一盏一盏点亮。

B548B9103F2383DE58BA25E42B897DB3.source: A very small cottage with a very large door knocker, as if to make up for it.
B548B9103F2383DE58BA25E42B897DB3.target: 一间非常小的小屋，配着一个非常大的门环，像是要弥补点什么。

B1723EEA5655D8DCD3E0B50AE982184B.source: Mother Celandine will ring the bell at dusk. Listen from the {Rampart Walk} — the whole town hums with it.
B1723EEA5655D8DCD3E0B50AE982184B.target: 黄昏时塞兰丁院长会敲钟。到{城墙步道}上听吧——整座城都会随之共鸣。

B4100E283F9FFB2C79BE123DF8E99CE1.source: Down in town there's an older mill, under the {Gildfall}. Runs on water, not wind. Show-off.
B4100E283F9FFB2C79BE123DF8E99CE1.target: 城里还有座更老的磨坊，就在{鎏金瀑布}底下。靠水转，不靠风。真会显摆。

B5290F669882D98918D09378E3BB3408.source: Look up at the cliff. That is the {Lookout}, at the end of the {Rampart Walk}. Captain Hale watches the barges from there, and pretends she is not watching me.
B5290F669882D98918D09378E3BB3408.target: 抬头看那悬崖。那就是{瞭望台}，在{城墙步道}的尽头。黑尔队长在那儿盯着驳船，还假装没在盯着我。

B8422D9D761CFAEFED2CE759C6208063.source: Three hundred years that bell has rung. It cracked once, in a hard winter. We mended it with gold leaf — a little of everything in Gildhaven is.
B8422D9D761CFAEFED2CE759C6208063.target: 那口钟已经响了三百年。有一年严冬它裂过一次，我们用金箔把它补好了——在鎏金港，每样东西多少都用金箔补过一点。

B8475B9A405FFDF2051F69FA6FAF9B2E.source: At dusk the {Sunspire Bell} rings the fair closed, and the Lord Mayor lights the lanterns along the river. Bring a coat. And a sweetheart, if you have one going spare.
B8475B9A405FFDF2051F69FA6FAF9B2E.target: 黄昏时{日塔之钟}敲响，集市落幕，市长大人会点亮沿河的灯笼。记得带件外套。要是有闲着的心上人，也一并带上。

BA459690A8080E7DB3CE087EBB6F3DA7.source: Fairfield Mill grinds for half the valley. On fair day, it grinds for the bakers, and the bakers grind me.
BA459690A8080E7DB3CE087EBB6F3DA7.target: 集原磨坊给半个山谷磨面。到了集市日，它专给面包师磨，面包师就来磨我。

BDD7F6D715B30054A7D51BD1B427ED45.source: Above the door hangs a goose of beaten gold leaf. It has been stolen eleven times. It always comes back.
BDD7F6D715B30054A7D51BD1B427ED45.target: 门上挂着一只金箔打成的鹅。它被偷过十一次，每次都会自己回来。

BE78D0419F0B14DA14058D1331362C93.source: Apple-crates are stacked high by the door. A note: "Gone to sell apples. Take one, leave a coin. — H."
BE78D0419F0B14DA14058D1331362C93.target: 门边高高摞着苹果箱。纸条上写着：“卖苹果去了。拿一个，留一枚硬币。——H”

BFFB1F02FDC3A755F96877E598437147.source: A big family by the sound of it, all of them looking for the same left shoe.
BFFB1F02FDC3A755F96877E598437147.target: 听动静是一大家子人，全都在找同一只左脚的鞋。

C16B563FE93A41EDEDD9D0C4BE78D758.source: The {Sun Well}. Its water is said to taste of honey on fair day.
C16B563FE93A41EDEDD9D0C4BE78D758.target: {太阳井}。据说到了集市日，井水会带着蜂蜜的甜味。

C92C36B866C3435E854107F3469F7064.source: Nets drying in great brown waves. It smells of the sea, and slightly of someone's lunch.
C92C36B866C3435E854107F3469F7064.target: 渔网晾成一道道棕色的大浪。闻起来有海的味道，还隐约有谁的午饭味。

C97E88D551A327F535DB25041B9BC759.source: Nobody answers, but a parrot inside says "Fair day! Fair day!" with great conviction.
C97E88D551A327F535DB25041B9BC759.target: 没人应门，屋里却有只鹦鹉斩钉截铁地叫着：“集市日！集市日！”

C0567D85AD5DB2C54C57D8A2B40C8CAC.source: After the fair we follow the {King's Road} south. Next week, a wedding. Then a funeral. Then another wedding. Busy season.
C0567D85AD5DB2C54C57D8A2B40C8CAC.target: 集市散了，我们就沿着{王之大道}南下。下周有场婚礼，然后是场葬礼，接着又是一场婚礼。旺季嘛。

C841A5635592D02CE89DB1EE8CBA02D4.source: Lovely day. Lovely crowd. Lovely... heavy... cloth.
C841A5635592D02CE89DB1EE8CBA02D4.target: 好天气。好热闹。好……沉甸甸的……衣料。

CAD1B513A305B001E87C54F619B25A8B.source: Came up the {King's Road} from the coast. You can smell the fair from a mile off — toffee, woodsmoke and cattle.
CAD1B513A305B001E87C54F619B25A8B.target: 我从海边沿着{王之大道}一路上来。隔着老远就能闻到集市的味道——太妃糖、柴烟，还有牛。

CB99A2165EFAE90A294077F1206FEB90.source: The {Gild Well}. They say the first barge-folk washed gold dust out of the river here, and the town was named for it.
CB99A2165EFAE90A294077F1206FEB90.target: {鎏金井}。据说最早的船民就在这里从河中淘出金沙，小镇也因此得名。

CBD2970E50D6EDF74F6BE0A56C167D5B.source: Takes me till the bell has stopped ringing. By then the first ones want trimming. A lamplighter's work is never done, only dim.
CBD2970E50D6EDF74F6BE0A56C167D5B.target: 要一直忙到钟声停下。到那时，最早点的那几盏又该剪灯芯了。点灯人的活儿从来没有干完的时候，只有灯暗的时候。

CC347EB36E856D0D53EE2E28A9F4B73D.source: A cheerful voice: "Come back after the bell! We are all down at the fair until then — even the kettle."
CC347EB36E856D0D53EE2E28A9F4B73D.target: 一个愉快的声音传来：“等钟响了再来吧！在那之前我们全都在集市上——连水壶也去了。”

CCF9A044C457528BB59A53E3F6DB4B33.source: If you lose something, the {Watch House} is up in {High Town}, east along {Crown Walk}. Captain Hale will be up at the {Lookout}, mind — she always is.
CCF9A044C457528BB59A53E3F6DB4B33.target: 要是丢了东西，{卫兵所}在{上城}，沿{王冠步道}往东走。不过黑尔队长肯定在{瞭望台}上——她总是在那儿。

CE921095E6B05C2E1A36FDF16AF6DA55.source: Saffron buns, hot from the {Saffron Bakery}! The saffron comes from Azar's stall on the square. Azar charges like a pirate, but oh, the colour.
CE921095E6B05C2E1A36FDF16AF6DA55.target: 藏红花面包，{藏红花面包房}刚出炉的！藏红花是从广场上阿扎尔的摊子买的。阿扎尔要价跟海盗似的，可是哎呀，那颜色！

CF97F282C25D563292214E7491AF7082.source: Empty. A kettle on the hob and two mugs, both labelled "SERGEANT".
CF97F282C25D563292214E7491AF7082.target: 空无一人。炉架上放着一把水壶，还有两只杯子，都写着“中士”。

D07D8352D18FC9200C8AAF459B798640.source: Milk! Fresh this morning from {Fairfield}! ...Sold out by noon. I am just walking the empty pails home, for the exercise.
D07D8352D18FC9200C8AAF459B798640.target: 牛奶！今早刚从{集原}运来的新鲜牛奶！……中午前就卖完了。我现在只是拎着空桶走回家，权当锻炼。

D033ADCAECD20AFC3530044811D5F309.source: Keep your purse close today. Fair days bring three things to {Gildhaven}: farmers, players and fingers.
D033ADCAECD20AFC3530044811D5F309.target: 今天看好你的钱袋。每逢集市日，{鎏金港}就会来三样东西：农夫、艺人，还有三只手。

D41EEB9A58A5E030B03F2EB0FCF7241F.source: The bell rings the fair closed at dusk
D41EEB9A58A5E030B03F2EB0FCF7241F.target: 黄昏钟声宣告集市落幕

D214BE1CE4A384B250D5989368ED7631.source: Hollyhocks by the door, taller than you. They nod as if they know you.
D214BE1CE4A384B250D5989368ED7631.target: 门边的蜀葵比你还高。它们频频点头，好像认识你似的。

D391235F2FDE0BD65969322202457D9E.source: Goodman Hollis says the hens are STAFF. So I am helping them do their job. Their job is running.
D391235F2FDE0BD65969322202457D9E.target: 霍利斯大叔说母鸡是“员工”。所以我在帮它们干活。它们的活儿就是跑。

D7666543D4213090A30EF788EF06799E.source: Fresh this morning! Gild trout, river eels, and a pike so ugly it frightened the cat.
D7666543D4213090A30EF788EF06799E.target: 今早刚到的！鎏金鳟鱼、河鳗，还有一条丑得把猫都吓跑了的梭子鱼。

D305491260A09E0DFC9BFF8194804DB4.source: I have bought a hat. I did not need a hat. It is the most beautiful hat in {Gildhaven}, and therefore the world.
D305491260A09E0DFC9BFF8194804DB4.target: 我买了一顶帽子。我并不需要帽子。可这是{鎏金港}最美的帽子，因此也就是全世界最美的帽子。

DA5BD8683FC213C4B8440FC134C72C5F.source: Pippin Orchard. Every apple on every toffee stick at the fair grew on these trees.
DA5BD8683FC213C4B8440FC134C72C5F.target: 这里是皮平果园。集市上每根太妃糖签子上的苹果，都是这些树上长的。

E4A7681535D6D4814DF0C2EDA1FA0E54.source: I have a list. Cheese, cloth, eggs, saffron. I have bought three ribbons. The list is not going well.
E4A7681535D6D4814DF0C2EDA1FA0E54.target: 我列了张单子：奶酪、布、鸡蛋、藏红花。结果我买了三条丝带。这张单子进展得不太顺利。

E5B439A71DE91AB0D3C5834D58AB5959.source: Fair ribbons! Tie one on your wrist and the music finds you. That is the custom. Or I made it up. One of those.
E5B439A71DE91AB0D3C5834D58AB5959.target: 集市丝带！系一条在手腕上，音乐就会找上你。这是习俗。也可能是我瞎编的。总之是其中之一。

E5C6BE4317053179B98F33AFA186F59F.source: Market Day on the River Gild

E5F26EB6644E06595245131D8129DF77.source: Rope, tar, candles, nails, a stuffed pike and, for some reason, a harp. "We have everything," says the sign. It may be right.
E5F26EB6644E06595245131D8129DF77.target: 绳子、焦油、蜡烛、钉子、一条梭子鱼标本，还有一架不知为何会在这里的竖琴。招牌上写着：“应有尽有。”也许真是这样。

E62C1FFE0114E2A3E6EFA70A03A4ACC7.source: Locked. Through a crack: sacks of salt piled to the rafters, and a cat asleep on the highest one.
E62C1FFE0114E2A3E6EFA70A03A4ACC7.target: 锁着。从门缝望进去：盐袋一直堆到房梁，最高的那袋上睡着一只猫。

E95D5EA598CD674147DCFADCC4A2218F.source: A maid peers out. "Lady Thornbury is not at home. Lady Thornbury is at the fair, buying a hat she does not need."
E95D5EA598CD674147DCFADCC4A2218F.target: 一名女仆探出头来：“索恩伯里夫人不在家。索恩伯里夫人去集市了，去买一顶她根本用不着的帽子。”

E516AF004F40D0941383B23833B825A1.source: Customs. Every barge declares its cargo, and I write it in the book. Today I have written "cheese" one hundred and four times.
E516AF004F40D0941383B23833B825A1.target: 这里是海关。每艘驳船都要申报货物，由我记进账簿。今天我已经写了一百零四遍“奶酪”。

E645ABDA9DDCB9BE2E25ADD2050DCAE5.source: Three apples, two knives and a turnip. The turnip is the dangerous one. Nobody expects the turnip.
E645ABDA9DDCB9BE2E25ADD2050DCAE5.target: 三个苹果、两把刀，再加一根萝卜。最危险的是萝卜。谁也想不到会是萝卜。

E2852DE55E556BBADB57C2D91EFEA4F3.source: If you want the history of the fair, it is in chapter nine. If you want the gossip, it is in the Barrelhouse.
E2852DE55E556BBADB57C2D91EFEA4F3.target: 想了解集市的历史，请看第九章。想听闲话，请去酒桶屋。

E4734AC10B63D879C442A20C224BCF56.source: The Abbey, the Hall and the Rampart Walk
E4734AC10B63D879C442A20C224BCF56.target: 修道院、市政厅与城墙步道

E17195E317708610142DACD98C2463BE.source: Closed for the fair. A slate by the door reads: "NO SCHOOL TODAY. Yes, really. Go away. — Dame Agnes"
E17195E317708610142DACD98C2463BE.target: 因集市停课。门边的石板上写着：“今日停课。没错，是真的。快走吧。——阿格尼丝老师”

E41844FEE2B08370763D33F3C2D7C047.source: One pinch of my saffron and the bakers of {Lantern Row} fight in the street. I have seen it. I sold them tickets.
E41844FEE2B08370763D33F3C2D7C047.target: 只要一撮我的藏红花，{灯笼巷}的面包师们就会当街打起来。我亲眼见过。我还卖过门票呢。

F5F11E891C78353096663A3CCDCC0B53.source: The {Saltbridge} to the east, {Kingsbridge} in the middle, and the {Mistbridge} by the falls — three bridges, and I have to count the tolls on all of them.
F5F11E891C78353096663A3CCDCC0B53.target: 东边是{盐桥}，中间是{王桥}，瀑布旁是{雾桥}——三座桥，过桥费全得我来算。

F27CC242E750F0C749FB52033A9AA237.source: Outside the South Gate · Fair day

F620E0F624445B0C3AE60E43BAC63D9C.source: The clack of a loom. A voice counts "...forty-one, forty-two, forty — oh, BOTHER."
F620E0F624445B0C3AE60E43BAC63D9C.target: 织机咔嗒作响。有个声音在数：“……四十一、四十二、四十——哎呀，烦死了！”

F92869977E76C8465D216AF9E06F9685.source: Light a thought for the river, friend. It gives this town everything — even its name.
F92869977E76C8465D216AF9E06F9685.target: 为这条河点一份念想吧，朋友。它给了这座城一切——连名字也是。

F263328470CA18C52AD9AE926CC17673.source: Welcome to {The Gilded Goose}! Every room is full of fair-folk, but I always keep one bed aired for a traveller.
F263328470CA18C52AD9AE926CC17673.target: 欢迎光临{金鹅旅店}！房间都住满了赶集的人，不过我总会给旅人留一张晾好被褥的床。

FC16DFC65A6289A26D14EDEABDAB3F00.source: A smell hits you before the door does. You decide not to knock twice.
FC16DFC65A6289A26D14EDEABDAB3F00.target: 还没碰到门，一股气味就先扑了过来。你决定不敲第二下了。

FC34E8832725DD949A2EE719254271E1.source: Long ago the barge-folk found gold dust in the river below the falls. There was not much, but they named the town for it, and they have been gilding everything since.
FC34E8832725DD949A2EE719254271E1.target: 很久以前，船民们在瀑布下的河里发现了金沙。数量不多，可他们还是用它给小镇命了名，此后便事事都要鎏上一层金。
